findings.description: Friedrich Carl Weber and Catharina Carell had a daughter, Anna Maria Eva Weber, born 26 February 1870 in Höchst, Hesse-Nassau. Her parentage is confirmed by two independent entries in the same parish register collection: the original baptismal entry naming parents Karl Weber and Katharina Karell, and a second entry recording her baptism on 13 March 1870 with the same parents and birth date. She is not the couple's first known child — an earlier daughter, Rosina, was baptized 3 May 1869 in Nied, naming the same parents (Carl Friedrich Weber and Catharina Karel).
